**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11 of the agreement satisfies the preferred TRANSITION position on every material term:

- **§ 11.1** — up to six months' transition assistance on request, at expiring Order Form rates, including knowledge transfer, export support, replacement-supplier cooperation, migration, and continued service at existing service levels (exceeds the 90-day fallback).
- **§ 11.2** — return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata; no withholding for fee disputes (a customer-favorable addition).
- **§ 11.3** — secure deletion from active systems and backups after we confirm successful return, with written certification by an authorized officer; any law-required retained copy stays protected and use-restricted.

No walk-away triggers are present (no immediate deletion on termination, no refusal to return data), so we leave the clause as drafted.
